# Canvink Math Golden Fixtures

All expressions in `golden.json` were authored specifically for Canvink on
2026-08-03. They contain typed LaTeX only and are released with the Canvink
test suite under the repository license. No CROHME, MathWriting, TexTeller,
Mathpix, scraped handwriting, or third-party research dataset was used.

The fixture deliberately covers only the locally released v0.2 engine scope.
Handwriting recognition accuracy is measured by a separate, consented corpus
and must never be inferred from these deterministic calculation tests.
